topic: Why gas stations barely profit from gasoline itself

sources.claim: Fuel retail margins are notoriously thin, often just a few cents per gallon of net profit after costs, and can turn negative during price swings
sources.source: Widely reported convenience-retail industry data (NACS/convenience-store trade press) and business journalism on fuel retailing economics

sources.claim: In-store convenience items (snacks, drinks, prepared food/coffee) carry far higher percentage profit margins than fuel, and represent the bulk of a station's actual profit
sources.source: Widely reported convenience-retail industry data on in-store vs. fuel margins
